pEffectiveSource: prior rim-calibration training-only fit, effective parameter not physical rate; fixed this batch
split: existing chronological schedule midpoint; use first halves pooled for two new hazard estimates; second halves validate
calibrationPilot: baseline with rim flag off, four seasons x 256 uniformly spaced schedule games x three seeds; estimate eligible opportunity exposures in train half

parameters.freshClockProbability: real train other clock events per game divided by simulated eligible fresh possessions per game; one league constant
parameters.postOrebClockProbability: real train individual-FG-OREB-following clock events per game divided by simulated eligible individual FG OREB opportunities per game; one league constant

eligible: period clock > current shot clock; strict period-priority exclusion; post draw once immediately after individual FG OREB, no repeat after foul/team rebound

mechanisms.competingFreshClock: replace original total-target fresh-clock probability with residual-path probability
mechanisms.postOrebDeadline: independent RNG, choose failure to release before deadline versus existing conditional successful-release timing; timeout consumes remaining clock and no FG/OREB emitted
mechanisms.rimContactClock: previous module, fixed pEffective; separately switchable

ablation: diagnostic three seeds, full schedule: baseline / fresh-only / post-only / combined; pilot is separately cached

validation.eventRate: heldout differences and uncertainty reported; immediate and post-OREB rates tested using 95% interval of difference with season-stratified game and seed resampling; interval must include 0
validation.existingBias: do not retune non-clock TOV, FG, pace, or rebound; compare their changes to baseline, explicitly report historical bias
validation.fullEvaluation: if combined event gates pass, run full 20 seeds; centered net RMSE and wins MAE differences use franchise+seed paired bootstrap 20000; no significant worsening for adoption
validation.leagueGates: efficiency abs bias <=0.5 each season; no existing TOV/FG/3P/OREB/DREB absolute-error deterioration beyond 0.1 in corresponding units versus paired baseline

restrictions: no team/player IDs or net/wins calibration
not a measurement of physical rim contact
no new seasons or new source hunt
no unbounded sampling from mixed event CDF tail
